Subject: Re: Follow-up: Pen test report + vendor questionnaire

Hi Raj — thanks for the questions. High-level answers below; attaching a redacted copy of our most recent pen test and our vulnerability management SLA doc. Happy to redact additional details if needed for public procurement.

Pen test:
- Last external pen test: Aug 2026 (third-party vendor). We will share a redacted report (sensitive IP and exact exploit PoCs removed). See attached: redwood-pen-test-report-2026-redacted.pdf
- Frequency: external full-scope pen test annually; scoped testing for major releases or architecture changes.

SOC 2 / Compliance:
- SOC 2 Type II: most recent report completed 2026-08; we can provide the cover letter and auditor contact under NDA/controlled distribution.
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA deployments and offer a BAA; encryption at rest/in-transit and access controls are in place.
- GDPR: DPA available; data residency options via Dedicated/Private deployments.

Vulnerability management (summary):
- Scanning cadence: automated internal scans (SAST/DAST) run weekly; external network scans weekly for public endpoints; container/image scans on CI per-build.
- Continuous monitoring: 24/7 detection/alerting with automated threat intelligence feeds and CVE monitoring.
- Triage SLAs: Critical (CVSS >=9): acknowledge within 4 hours, mitigation plan within 72 hours. High (7-8.9): acknowledge within 24 hours, mitigation plan within 7 days. Medium/Low: acknowledged within 3 business days, remediation per agreed prioritization (30/90 days where applicable).
- Patch windows: we target hotfixes for Critical within 30 days; High prioritized into sprint cycles and tracked to closure.
- Disclosure policy: coordinated disclosure with customers and researchers; typical embargo 30 days for critical issues unless otherwise negotiated.
- Responsible disclosure: we accept reports via security@redwood.ai and have a bug bounty/triage program with partner platforms.

Attachments: redwood-pen-test-report-2026-redacted.pdf, vuln-management-sla-2026.pdf

If you want a short technical call to walk through the report and SLA details, I'm available 12/15-12/17 mornings PST.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
